description: This Dart source file defines the UI screens for the quiz list and quiz detail views in a Flutter application. It includes widgets for listing available quizzes, starting a quiz, presenting questions, and showing results. The file manages navigation and state updates during quiz interactions.

classes.name: QuizListScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget that displays a list of available quizzes as interactive cards, allowing users to start a quiz or view their last score.

classes.name: QuizDetailScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget that manages and presents the quiz questions for a specific quiz ID, allowing users to answer questions and submit their scores.

classes.name: QuizResultScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays the final score and provides an option to finish the quiz.

classes.name: MockQuizUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing a method to find a quiz by ID from the mock data.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state, setting up quiz progress store and current quiz data.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the quiz list or quiz detail, rendering questions, answers, and navigation controls.

methods.name: onPressed
methods.description: Handles user interactions for starting quizzes, selecting answers, and navigating between screens.
